searchText: I followed <@808969530608451584> approach to use a static gas limit. The exact gas usage is quite tricky due to the total queue behavior. My batch approach is only relevant from the user perspective. I mean in terms of speed. In the end each EL request is one transaction.

excerpts.author: tobiwo
excerpts.content:
I followed <@808969530608451584> approach to use a static gas limit. The exact gas usage is quite tricky due to the total queue behavior. 
My batch approach is only relevant from the user perspective. I mean in terms of speed. In the end each EL request is one transaction.
